title: Write and publish articles on trending topics with agents
summary: Julian Goldie describes a Grokbot research agent and content agent that find trending topics and publish articles; he reports four sites reaching 35 to 1,300 daily clicks.
agent_role: A research agent scans the web daily for trending topics and passes them on; a content agent writes and publishes articles to the site. The author says a human should add real experience and check each article before it goes live.
outcome: The author reports one article reaching 34 clicks a day within 24 hours, and four sites growing from zero to 35, 79, 235 and 1,300 clicks a day.
what_they_did: The author set up a research bot in Grokbot that scans the web every day for what is taking off in AI agents. He connected Netlify so agents publish straight to his site. A content bot, given his search-ranking writing guide, writes an article on each trending topic.
how_it_went: He reports one article hit 34 clicks a day within a day of posting. He says four sites built this way went from zero to 35, 79, 235 and 1,300 clicks a day.
worth_knowing: He advises adding your own real experience to every article and checking each one by hand before it goes live. The post ends with a pitch to message him for the full guide.
prompt: Every morning, search the web for topics in [your niche] that started trending this week. Give me the top three with why each is rising. For the one I pick, draft an article for [your website] using this style guide: [your guide]. Leave a marked spot for me to add my own experience. Show me the full draft and wait for my approval before publishing anything.

curation.rationale: Describes a two-agent setup that researches trending topics daily and writes and publishes articles, with traffic numbers. It leans promotional (DM for the guide) and the numbers are unverified.
